policy.patches: Induced graph of vertices <=2 edges from root; signed lift directions; no rotation quotient; unwrap torus.
policy.pressure: EA=1, beam radius=.03, sub=2, uniform hydrostatic stress. Minimum of optimized acoustic threshold and Bloch scan.
policy.primary_bloch_grid: Gamma and (i/4,j/4), i,j=0,1,2,3, modulo k~-k (10 non-Gamma points).
policy.Penrose_reference_source: the main code gives .8106; own pre-existing free-reference estimate .81054; constant normalization does not affect ranks.
policy.F1: PASS iff N_AB>=40, all four families present, and Spearman(phi2,Delta)>=.9.
policy.F2: PASS iff rho_phi2 >= every signed competitor rho. Report paired bootstrap 95% CIs; registration specifies no CI decision rule.
policy.F3: Fit g(x)=a*x+b*x^2, a,b>=0, AB only. Penrose predictions g(phi2), scale fixed to 1 (no Penrose fit). PASS iff N>=30, all three families, rho>=.85.
policy.F4: Test zero-phi2 Pell sequence; isotropic angular mean c0 (8 directions). Fit Delta_iso=c+a*abs(delta)+b*delta^2. 95% bootstrap CI for a, both all orders and three finest. Finite consistency is not proof of universal/asymptotic statement; report binary with scope.
policy.bootstrap: 10000 paired, stratified by family and clustered by period (two phase/MC replicates); percentile 95% CI; seed 864108.
policy.alternatives: Centered internal variance and true Euclidean max/mean excess from each rational-cut projected cube. Moved fraction relative to same-period/same-phase canonical vertex set. These are periodic well-defined.
policy.equilibration: Uniform-vertex legal flips, beta=0; 5000 burn-in sweeps, then 20 blocks of 500 sweeps. Retain traces, paired-chain diagnostics by period.
policy.discs: Uniform beta=0 legal flips restricted to old AND new site in disc; 15000 global-vertex sweeps.
policy.heldout: Fresh RNG, independent randomly rounded oblique primitive periods, no old observations or snapshots; F4 controls excluded from held-out cohorts.
